title: Completed normalized interchange is the canonical integral braiding
statement: For one integral dualizing datum A with a symmetry natural in both variables, the explicit completion conjugate completedInterchange A on integral constructible objects equals the canonical pullbackTensorIntegralBraiding of the completed integral tensor.

source.place: Paragraph 3, signed transposition and completion conjugation

proof.text: Transport the strict-system braiding through the completed tensor model. Its reduction square is the adjunction counit naturality square, so uniqueness identifies it with the canonical constructible integral braiding.

proof.text: Make the supplied natural swap into a natural transformation. On good representatives, cancel the ordinary tensor presentation and completed tensor comparison, and use their representative equations and completion_signed_representative. The product localization universal property extends this equality to all derived inputs.

proof.text: At constructible inputs compose the natural transformation identity with the inverse completion map. Its inverse-hom identity gives the claimed equality of completedInterchange with the canonical braiding.

theorem completedInterchange_eq_integralBraiding
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (w : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl E)
    (A : Datum D l hl X E w)
    (hA : ∀ (K M K' M' : IntegralHom.Derived.{u, u} X
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X))
      (f : K ⟶ K') (g : M ⟶ M'),
      A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ (A.symmetry.swap K' M').hom =
        (A.symmetry.swap K M).hom ≫ A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom g f))
    (K M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) :
    completedInterchange D l hl X E w A K M =
      (pullbackTensorIntegralBraiding l E X (hW := units D l hl X) K M).hom
